arStrings.szText: {c_important}Command Fallen{/c} summons a Mega Lunatic which deals {c_number}{payload:EXPLOSION_MEGA}{/c} damage and bursts into {c_number}{SF_23}{/c} Mini Lunatics which each deal {c_number}{payload:EXPLOSION_MINI}{/c} damage.

{c_important}Command Fallen{/c} becomes a {c_important}Hellfire{/c} Skill and passively summons a Lunatic every {c_number}[{SF_11}|1|]{/c} |4second:seconds; that follows you around and detonates when enemies get close, up to {c_number}{SF_7}{/c} Lunatics. Summon rate is based on your Attack Speed.

{c_important}Command Fallen{/c} is also an {c_important}Abyss{/c} Skill and now summons up to {c_number}{SF_9}{/c} Fallen Grunts for {c_number}{SF_8}{/c} seconds which deal {c_number}{payload:GRUNT_SWIPE}{/c} damage and generate {c_number}{SF_5}{/c} Wrath per hit. Recasting while all are active will direct them to move or target on your command.
{c_important}Command Fallen{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_14}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage for every Demon you have active, up to {c_number}[{SF_14}*{SF_15}*100|x%|]{/c}.

{c_important}Command Fallen{/c} generates {c_number}{SF_16}{/c} additional Wrath for every Demon or Enemy you have killed in the last {c_number}{SF_17}{/c} seconds, up to {c_number}[{SF_16}*{SF_18}]{/c} additional Wrath.
Your Demons summoned by {c_important}Command Fallen{/c} deal {c_number}[{SF_19}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage for every second they are alive, up to {c_number}[{SF_20}*100|x%|]{/c}.
Every {c_number}{SF_22}{/c} times you hit enemies with {c_important}Command Fallen{/c} you gain {c_number}{SF_21}{/c} Dominance.
